Option 1 · from the PDF itself

Use when the PDF was made digitally (you can select the figure's text). Most accurate — it reads exact coordinates. Won't work on scans.

Use when the page is a scan or option 1 found nothing. Follows each coloured curve pixel by pixel. Black/grey lines are skipped, and crossings need checking in step 4.
